factories.name: newListChannelsStep
factories.description: Find Slack channels and their channel IDs. Call this first whenever the user names a channel, such as #general, and pass the returned channelId to other Slack tools instead of asking the user for an ID. Optionally supply part of the channel name (case-insensitive; a leading # is ignored), visibility public or private, memberOnly true to list only channels the app has joined, a limit from 1 through 999, and the cursor from the previous page. The name filter applies to each page separately, so a page can have no match: while nextCursor is present, call again with it. The app can post only where isMember is true, and a private channel appears only after the app is added to it.

inputSchema.description: ListChannelsInput selects one page of Slack channels visible to the connection's app.

cursor.description: Cursor is the nextCursor from the previous page. Blank reads the first page.

limit.description: Limit is the number of channels Slack examines for this page, from 1 through 999, Slack's maximum. Zero uses 200. The name filter runs after Slack returns the page, so fewer channels can be returned.

memberOnly.description: MemberOnly lists only channels the app has joined, which are the channels it can post to. False also lists public channels the app has not joined.

nameFilter.description: NameFilter keeps only channels whose name contains this text, ignoring case, surrounding spaces, and one leading #, so "#General" matches general and general-ops. Blank keeps every channel on the page.

visibility.description: Visibility is public for public channels only or private for private channels only. Blank lists both.

factories.name: newGetWorkspaceIdentityStep
factories.description: Show which Slack workspace this connection is connected to and which bot posts for it. Takes no input. Returns the workspace name, ID, and URL, the Enterprise Grid organization ID when there is one, and the bot's user ID, user name, and bot ID. Use it to tell the user which workspace a message will go to.

inputSchema.description: GetWorkspaceIdentityInput takes no fields because the connection determines the workspace.

factories.name: newListThreadMessagesStep
factories.description: Read one page of messages from a Slack channel thread. Supply the channel ID, the parent message timestamp, a page size from 1 through 15, and the cursor from the previous page to continue.

inputSchema.description: ListThreadMessagesInput contains the provider request fields for list thread messages.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the Slack channel identifier.

cursor.description: Cursor specifies cursor for list thread messages input.

pageSize.description: PageSize specifies page size for list thread messages input.

threadTimestamp.description: ThreadTimestamp is the Slack parent message timestamp.

factories.name: newGetThreadReplyStep
factories.description: Read one reply in a Slack channel thread. Supply the channel ID, the parent message timestamp, and the reply's own timestamp.

inputSchema.description: GetThreadReplyInput contains the provider request fields for get thread reply.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the Slack channel identifier.

replyTimestamp.description: ReplyTimestamp is the Slack reply message timestamp.

threadTimestamp.description: ThreadTimestamp is the Slack parent message timestamp.

factories.name: newListChannelMessagesStep
factories.description: Read one page of recent top-level messages in a Slack channel, newest first; thread replies are not included, so use the Slack list_thread_messages tool for a thread. Supply the channel ID, optionally oldestTimestamp and latestTimestamp Slack message timestamps to bound the time range, isInclusive true to include messages at exactly those timestamps, a pageSize of 1 through 15 (blank or 0 reads 15), and the cursor from the previous page to continue while nextCursor is present. When the user names a channel, such as #general, first find its channelId with the Slack list_channels tool for the same connection. The app must be a member of the channel.

inputSchema.description: ListChannelMessagesInput selects one page of a Slack channel's top-level message history.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the Slack channel identifier, such as C0123456789, from listChannels or the channel picker.

cursor.description: Cursor is the nextCursor from the previous page. Blank reads the newest page.

isInclusive.description: IsInclusive also keeps messages whose timestamp equals OldestTimestamp or LatestTimestamp. Slack ignores it when both timestamps are blank.

latestTimestamp.description: LatestTimestamp keeps only messages before this Slack message timestamp, such as 1710000099.000100. Blank reads up to the newest message.

oldestTimestamp.description: OldestTimestamp keeps only messages after this Slack message timestamp, such as 1710000000.000100. Blank reads from the start of the channel's history.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the maximum number of messages on this page: 1 through 15; blank or 0 reads 15, the most Slack returns to a non-Marketplace app. Slack may return fewer messages while NextCursor continues the history.

factories.name: newPostChannelMessageStep
factories.description: Post one new top-level message to a Slack channel. Supply the channel ID and the message text. When the user names a channel, such as #general, first find its channelId with the Slack list_channels tool for the same connection; never ask the user for a channel ID that tool can find. The app must be a member of the channel.

inputSchema.description: PostChannelMessageInput contains the provider request fields for post channel message.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the Slack channel identifier.

text.description: Text specifies text for post channel message input.

factories.name: newPostThreadReplyStep
factories.description: Post one reply to an existing Slack channel thread. Supply the channel ID, the parent message timestamp, and the reply text. When the user names a channel, such as #general, find its channelId with the Slack list_channels tool for the same connection; never ask the user for a channel ID that tool can find.

inputSchema.description: PostThreadReplyInput contains the provider request fields for post thread reply.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the Slack channel identifier.

text.description: Text specifies text for post thread reply input.

threadTimestamp.description: ThreadTimestamp is the Slack parent message timestamp.
